description: Dry-run an automation on one stored inbox message: each condition's result, whether it would run, and the actions it would take. Nothing is changed, queued or sent. Needs messages:read as well as automations:read. A semantic condition calls the classifier only when every other condition matched, and that call counts against the AI budget. Limited to 10 tests a minute per key.
name: shipmail_test_automation

blocked_reasons.description: Why it would not run, empty when it would: automation_not_active, no_active_version, invalid_definition, policy_version_outdated, trigger_mailbox_outside_scope, owner_unavailable, message_not_live, mailbox_not_in_trigger and message_in_junk (test results only), models_disabled, model_budget_exhausted.

matched.description: Null when the condition was not evaluated.

model_calls.description: Classifier calls made; they count against the AI budget.

send_degraded_reasons.description: Runs, but writes drafts instead of sending: automatic_send_disabled (automatic sending is off), writing_style_required (the writing style it drafts with (pinned when it was saved) has not passed its check). Empty unless a Send-mode automation would only draft.

title: Test Automation on a Message
